result.summary: Overall layout looks clean; one minor issue found with heart icon contrast on a light image background.

issues.description: The white heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image has low contrast against the light-colored broth background, making it harder to see compared to the same icon on the darker pizza image below.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle dark background circle or shadow behind the heart icon consistently across all cards to ensure visibility regardless of underlying image color.
